title: Supervise What Decides Success: Criterion-Aligned Auxiliary Losses for Latent World-Model Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.01224v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent world models plan by scoring candidate action sequences with distances in latent space. However, task success is judged by physical quantities, which we call the success-criterion quantities. In all four latent world models we examine, the end-effector position is encoded in the latent state with an error larger than the success criterion allows. Such a latent state cannot separate successful candidates from failing ones. We propose an auxiliary loss that uses success-criterion quantities as training targets, whereas existing latent world models take them only as inputs. During training, a linear head on the encoder and predictor outputs regresses the success-criterion quantities, and the regression error is added to the training loss. The head is discarded after training, so the model, its cost, and its inputs at test time are unchanged. This loss alone improves the success rate on PushT and cube by 3.5% and 3.4% (absolute), resp

translated_title: 监督决定成败的因素：面向潜空间世界模型规划的准则对齐辅助损失
translated_abstract: 潜空间世界模型通过在潜空间中计算距离来为候选动作序列评分以进行规划。然而，任务的成功与否是由物理量来判断的，我们将其称为“成功准则量”。在我们考察的全部四个潜空间世界模型中，末端执行器位置在潜状态中的编码误差均超过了成功准则所允许的范围，这样的潜状态无法将成功的候选动作与失败的候选动作区分开来。我们提出一种辅助损失，将成功准则量作为训练目标，而现有的潜空间世界模型仅将其作为输入。训练过程中，编码器和预测器输出上的一个线性头对成功准则量进行回归，并将回归误差加入训练损失；训练结束后该线性头被丢弃，因此测试时的模型结构、计算成本和输入均保持不变。仅此一项损失即可将 PushT 和立方体任务的成功率分别（绝对值）提升 3.5% 和 3.4%。
tldr: 提出一种以任务成功准则量（如末端执行器位置）为回归目标的辅助损失，在不增加任何测试时成本的前提下修正潜空间表征，使其能够区分成功与失败的动作序列，从而显著提升潜空间世界模型规划的成功率。
en_tdlr: A criterion-aligned auxiliary loss that regresses success-criterion quantities during training fixes latent representations to distinguish successful from failing action sequences, improving latent world-model planning at no extra test-time cost.
